implemented_capabilities: Structured output validation and mandatory human review flag
Rules baseline for routing and missing-document requests
Optional LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning script
limitations: No real insurance/claimant data is included.
The rules baseline is deterministic and its evaluation labels are generated from the same rules.
Prior adapter evaluation on eight synthetic examples achieved 100% schema validity and queue match but 50% next-step accuracy; claim-ID and missing-document accuracy were not measured.
The training prompt and evaluator have been updated, but the existing adapter must be retrained before measuring the revised prompt.
The eight-example synthetic test is too small to support broad generalization claims.
No claim approval, denial, payout, fraud, liability, or coverage decision is made.
next_step: Retrain QLoRA with the revised prompt; then re-evaluate schema, route, next-step, claim-ID, missing-document, and human-review metrics. Do not use the prior adapter for real claims.
